verdict.rationale: Marqeta's first-party docs describe an authorization controls resource that limits where users can transact, either at a single merchant or at a group of merchants. That covers single-merchant locks and merchant-group restrictions, enforced through the authorization-control mechanism. The MCP Server docs also list merchant restrictions among the spend controls. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of MCC-based grouping, clear allowlist vs. blocklist semantics, documented detail on how controls are evaluated at authorization time, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
